 MADISON, Wis. — People and businesses in Wisconsin counties affected by April’s severe storms have until Monday to file many federal tax returns and pay taxes that were due during the relief period.
 Affected counties include Rock, Sauk, Iowa, Jefferson and Juneau. The deadline also applies to taxpayers who had a valid extension to file a 2025 return.
 Affected quarterly payroll tax returns and certain excise tax returns normally due April 30 and July 31, 2026, are also due Monday.
 The IRS says affected taxpayers who receive a penalty notice for a filing or payment deadline within the postponement period should call the number on the notice to request that the penalty be removed.
